name: Check Engine
meaning: Indicates a malfunction in the engine control unit, emissions system, or an ignition sensor.
action: Have the vehicle scanned for OBD-II fault codes as soon as possible. Safe to drive temporarily if the light is solid and not flashing.

name: ABS
meaning: Indicates a fault in the Anti-lock Braking System. Standard brakes will continue to work, but emergency ABS assistance is disabled.
action: Drive with caution, especially on slippery surfaces, and have the ABS speed sensors and module diagnosed.

name: Battery
meaning: Charging system fault. The alternator is not supplying power, or the battery is depleted.
action: Turn off non-essential systems (A/C, radio). Safely pull over and switch off the engine. The car may not restart if shut down.

name: Oil Pressure
meaning: Loss of engine oil pressure. Insufficient lubrication can destroy engine pistons and bearings in seconds.
action: Safely pull over and stop the engine immediately. Check oil level with dipstick. Do not restart the vehicle; call a tow service.

name: Brake System
meaning: Brake fluid level is dangerously low, or there is a failure in the main hydraulic braking circuit.
action: Ensure the handbrake is fully released. If light remains on, pull over immediately. Check brake fluid level and call for assistance.

name: Airbag
meaning: A diagnostic error has been detected in the Supplemental Restraint System (SRS/Airbag module).
action: Airbags and seatbelt pretensioners might fail to deploy in a collision. Seek mechanical assistance to scan and reset SRS.

name: Coolant Temp
meaning: Engine coolant temperature has exceeded safe limits. The engine is overheating.
action: Pull over safely and turn off the engine immediately. Do not open the radiator cap while hot to prevent severe steam burns.

name: TPMS
meaning: Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) alert. One or more tires are significantly under-inflated.
action: Stop at the nearest service station, check the tire pressures with a gauge, and inflate to the recommended PSI.

name: ESP
meaning: Electronic Stability Program (ESP) or traction control is disabled, turned off, or has experienced a system fault.
action: Vehicular slide protection is inactive. Drive carefully on wet, icy, or loose road surfaces.

name: Seat Belt
meaning: An occupant in the driver or passenger seat is unbuckled while the vehicle is in motion.
action: Fasten the seatbelt immediately before driving.

name: Automatic Emergency Braking
meaning: Collision warning system is disabled or blocked by dirt/snow on radar/camera sensors.
action: Clean the front bumper radar sensors and windshield camera lenses to restore active safety braking features.

name: Brake Pad Wear
meaning: Brake pad thickness has worn down past the safety limit indicators.
action: Schedule a brake service soon to replace the worn brake pads before rotors get damaged.

name: Cruise Control
meaning: Cruise control system is active and holding the designated speed.
action: Press the brake pedal or cruise cancel button to resume manual acceleration.

name: DPF Warning
meaning: Diesel Particulate Filter is saturated with soot and is unable to automatically regenerate.
action: Drive the vehicle on a highway at speeds above 50 mph (80 km/h) for 20 minutes to trigger active DPF regeneration.

name: Door Ajar
meaning: One or more passenger doors, hood, or the trunk lid is not fully closed.
action: Bring the vehicle to a stop and check all doors to make sure they are slammed shut securely.

name: Throttle Fault
meaning: Electronic Throttle Control (ETC) system fault. The vehicle may go into "limp home" mode with restricted speed.
action: Pull over, turn off ignition, wait 10 seconds, and restart. If light persists, seek immediate service.

name: High Beams
meaning: Windshield high beam headlights are turned on.
action: Dim headlights to low beams when approaching oncoming traffic or following other vehicles.

name: Lane Departure
meaning: The vehicle is drifting out of its lane without the turn signal activated.
action: Grip the steering wheel and correct the path to center the vehicle in the lane.

name: Low Brake Fluid
meaning: The volume of brake fluid in the master cylinder reservoir is low, suggesting a leak or highly worn brake pads.
action: Inspect reservoir. Top up with DOT-approved fluid. If fluid drops quickly, seek emergency brake system repair.

name: Low Fuel
meaning: The fuel level in the tank has dropped to reserve levels (typically less than 2 gallons).
action: Refuel at the nearest gas station immediately to avoid air entering the fuel injectors.

name: Power Steering
meaning: Electric power steering assist is inactive. Steering the car will feel significantly heavier.
action: Check hydraulic steering fluid (if equipped) or restart engine. Drive slowly and prepare for high steering effort.

name: Security Alert
meaning: Vehicle immobilizer security system is active or the key transponder was not recognized.
action: Ensure you are using the correct transponder key. Replace key fob batteries if remote entry fails to start engine.

name: Suspension Fault
meaning: Air suspension or active dampers have experienced a fault. Vehicle height may be restricted.
action: Drive at moderate speeds to a repair shop. Avoid hauling heavy loads or trailers.

name: Transmission Fault
meaning: An internal transmission component is overheating, slipping, or has lost electronic gear control.
action: Safely pull over. Let transmission cool down in Neutral. Do not continue driving if the engine revs without accelerating.

name: Washer Fluid Low
meaning: The windshield washer fluid level is low.
action: Refill the windshield washer fluid reservoir with seasonal wash solution.

name: Parking Brake
meaning: The electronic or manual parking brake is engaged.
action: Fully disengage the parking brake lever or switch before attempting to drive.

name: Turn Left Indicator
meaning: Left-hand turn signals are active.
action: Verify signal turns off automatically after completing your turn.

name: Turn Right Indicator
meaning: Right-hand turn signals are active.
action: Verify signal turns off automatically after completing your turn.
